baseline.name: The Administrative Baseline
baseline.tagline: The legal essentials, correctly filed the first time.
baseline.bestFor: Students in university housing who need the paperwork handled.
features: TIE / CUE National Police appointment booking
EX-17 or EX-18 form generation, pre-filled and print-ready
Modelo 790 Código 012 barcoded tax form setup
Pre-checked physical and digital “Ready File” assembly

soft-landing.name: The Digital Soft-Landing
soft-landing.tagline: Paperwork, plus everything that makes the city usable.
soft-landing.bestFor: Most first-year international students arriving alone.
features: Spanish bank account setup guidance (non-resident to resident)
Digital SIM / eSIM selection and activation guidance
Carnet Jove and ISIC student card configuration
Dedicated WhatsApp support line during onboarding

turnkey.name: The Turnkey Relocation & Housing Audit
turnkey.tagline: We verify the apartment before you wire a deposit.
turnkey.bestFor: Families securing private housing from abroad, sight unseen.
features: Verified housing sourcing against fraud-screened listings
Rental contract review with legal deposit-cap verification
90-day document tracking through to TIE card collection

page.metaDescription: Three fixed-fee packages for international students arriving in Barcelona: administrative baseline, digital soft-landing, and turnkey relocation with housing audit.
page.title: Fixed fees for a process with no fixed timeline.
page.intro: Every package is quoted exclusive of IVA and shown with its total including {rate}% IVA before you pay. Nothing is billed hourly, and no package includes government fees.
